facts.raw_span: A 22-year-old Japanese man
no medical history or family history
developed fever and erythema on trunk and extremities 3 days after receiving first dose of Moderna vaccine
C-reactive protein: 19.77 mg/dL
Leukocyte count: 12,480/μL
Serum ferritin: 443.1 ng/mL
D-dimer: 1.1 µg/mL
High-sensitivity troponin I: 6327 pg/mL
Total occlusion of atrioventricular branch of right coronary artery
90% stenotic lesions with >3 mm coronary ectasia in left circumflex artery
SARS-CoV-2 PCR test results were repeatedly negative
chest pain that was refractory and persistent
